[b][color=#d9d2e9][size=5]Nyapu's Style NPC Faust
[/size][/color][/b]This mod is a [CP] version, meaning you just need to extract the file to your mods folder and everything should work!
This mod makes the portraits of the NPC [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37246?tab=description]Faust the Gravekeeper - Custom NPC [/url]look like Nyapu's drawing style.

[b][color=#d9d2e9]New in version 1.1.0[/color][/b]
This is the CP version of the mod, so now you don't need to replace anything in the original mod!

[size=3]Thank you so much [/size][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/SukuroIsUseless]SukuroIsUseless[/url][size=3] for creating this character and for allowing me to post these portraits![/size]
